mapper.select: select d.dept_id from sys_dept d left join sys_role_dept rd on d.dept_id = rd.dept_id where rd.role_id = #{roleId} order by d.parent_id, d.order_num
select * from sys_dept where find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors)
select count(1) from sys_user where dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0'
